name: smwmusic-bee-hunter-the-loneliness
title: Bee Hunter - The Loneliness
description:
The Loneliness, composed by Bee Hunter of jazz (same guy who composed "Apoplexy", which is well-known in Mario Forever).

Thunder/Blargg sample and @7 (Bonus End fanfare) have been omitted in both versions, and @12 (P-Switch) has been omitted in the echoed version.

UPDATE
-Added a few missing pitch bends in channel 4.
-Enabling or disabling echo is now chosen inside the text file - #define ECHO_ON 1 to enable, #define ECHO_ON 0 to disable. Echo is enabled by default.
